question: Which state of India hosted the 2015 National Games of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kerala **hosted the** 2015 National Games **of India.
 
• The National Games is a biennial **multi-sport event** that showcases the best athletes from all over India.
 
• **Goa, Haryana, and Gujarat **have also hosted the **National Games **in the past.
 
• The **2015 National Games of India **were held from **January 31 to February 14**, and saw participation from over **10,000 athletes** across 36 sports.
 
• Kerala emerged as the overall champions of the** 2015 National Games**, with a total of **162 gold medals.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Goa** hosted the National Games in** 2014**, **Haryana** hosted it in **2009, **and **Gujarat **hosted it in **2011.**
 
• The** National Games **were first held in **1924**, and have since become an important platform for Indian athletes to showcase their** talent and compete at a national level.**
 
• The** 2015 National Games** were originally scheduled to be held in** 2014**, but were postponed due to various reasons such as **infrastructure issues** and political unrest in the host state of Kerala.
 
• The National Games have been instrumental in promoting sports and fitness culture in India, and have produced many notable athletes such as** P.T. Usha, Milkha Singh, and Saina Nehwal.**
